# `toolu delegate`

Submit committed work to registered machines.

Owner: `plugins/toolu`.

## `toolu delegate`

```text
Submit committed work to registered machines

Usage: toolu delegate [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  submit   Persist and submit a task
  status   Inspect, retry delivery or cancel a submitted task
  cancel   Inspect, retry delivery or cancel a submitted task
  retry    Inspect, retry delivery or cancel a submitted task
  results  Import a verified result under a private Git ref
  report   Write an attempt-bound worker outcome
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json              Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
  -q, --quiet             Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>       The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --config-dir <DIR>  Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help              Print help
```

## `toolu delegate submit`

```text
Persist and submit a task

Usage: toolu delegate submit [OPTIONS] --key <key> --repo <repo> --brief <brief> --agent <agent> [args]...

Arguments:
  [args]...  Agent flags after --

Options:
      --json               Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
      --key <key>          Caller-generated durable submission key
  -q, --quiet              Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --repo <repo>
      --brief <brief>      Path to the task brief
      --host <HOST>        The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --agent <agent>      [possible values: claude, codex, muse, cursor, opencode]
      --config-dir <DIR>   Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
      --machine <machine>
      --group <group>
  -h, --help               Print help
```

## `toolu delegate report`

```text
Write an attempt-bound worker outcome

Usage: toolu delegate report [OPTIONS] --file <file> --attempt <attempt> --base <base> --commit <commit> --status <status>

Options:
      --file <file>
      --json               Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
      --attempt <attempt>
  -q, --quiet              Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --base <base>
      --host <HOST>        The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --commit <commit>
      --config-dir <DIR>   Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
      --repo <repo>        Worker repository; defaults to current directory
      --status <status>    [possible values: done, failed]
      --note <note>        [default: ""]
  -h, --help               Print help
```
